Title: 🪙 Chaos to productivity gold

URL Source: https://www.neurohackingly.com/chaos-to-productivity-gold

Published Time: 2025-06-23T22:37:40.000Z

Markdown Content:
Ever feel like you’re drowning in complex tasks with no roadmap?

I’ve been there. Until I discovered these two game-changers.

Problem #1: “I know WHAT I want, but not HOW to get there”
----------------------------------------------------------

**Solution: Gemini’s Checklist Superpower 💎**

Last month, [my AI course](https://www.produktiv.me/ki/) sold out in 72 hours. But setting it up? A nightmare.

□ Registration forms

□ Payment processing

□ Course access system

So I did what I always do when things get complicated.

I sketched it out.

![Image 1: Rough workflow diagram sketched in Figjam](https://www.neurohackingly.com/images/chaos-to-productivity-gold/image-4.png)

A rough workflow in Figjam

Then I prompted Gemini:

> Create a detailed checklist of what I need to do to follow the workflow described in the diagram. Fill any gaps or things I may have missed. Keep it as simple, but also as detailed as possible.

Prompt Gemini for checklist. Export to Google Docs. Enjoy the satisfaction of checking off boxes.

17 happy participants. Zero tech headaches.

Problem #2: “Creating presentations takes so long”
--------------------------------------------------

**Solution: Claude as Your Writing, Design and Tech Team ✴️**

Prezi wants $180/year. Claude Pro does it better.

I love Prezi’s interactive storylines.

I did the following:

1. Searched for a Prezi presentation I liked.
2. Took some screenshots of slides.
3. Recorded a voice memo of the context I need the presentation for.
4. Asked Claude to create a 40 slide presentation in HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

That’s how I turned a boring presentation into a premium desert island experience.

One prompt = 80% done.

There is even a treasure map in the upper right corner that you can fold out to see where you are.

It even made a workbook.

Time saved: 8 hours.

What’s the ONE task you’d love to delegate to AI this week?

Have a great week,

Lukas
